data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'hubb' meaning 'love', 'affection'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the love and devotion towards Allah and His Prophet. The name Hubbah carries the meaning “Love, Affection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hubbah usually hope their child will grow to embody love, affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hubbah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
